3b8ba9d9: If X is null and DV doesn't contain 'R', go to A. If X is null and DV contains 'R', go to X. If D is less than or equal to 0, go to X. Otherwise, go to A
c8d0a342: If X is '?', go to QS. If X starts with '^', execute D and go to ^DIE17
0b417cb3: If X is '@', execute D and go to Z^DIE2
96ba50b6: If X is a space, DV contains 'd' but not 'P', and the user has a value stored in ^DISV(DUZ,'DIE',DLB), set X to that value. If DV doesn't contain 'D' or 'S', write out the value of X

d970ac01: If DV contains 'V', go to M^DIE17. If DV contains 'V', go to ^DIE3. If DV doesn't contain 'S', go to P. If the field has DIC("S") code, execute it. If the result is true, write out the value if DB(DQ) isn't defined, then go to V

ae3d5ab9: Loop through the semicolon-pieces of DU. For each piece, check if it contains X followed by a colon. If so, execute DIC("S") code if it exists and the result is true. Exit the loop if a match is found
01b22d77: If DB(DQ) isn't defined, write out the remainder of the current semicolon-piece starting from where X was found. Set X to the piece before the colon
fd6f3c09: If the lookup fails, quit.
623995ab: If the data value is numeric and greater than 24 characters long, invalidate it.
0d3c3114: Perform transformations on numeric values with decimal points and commas.
55481f43: Execute data validation code and clear utility node.
90d0cdff: Save validated input value in global data storage, if applicable.
f983f2f8: If there is a DATA subentry for this field, jump to node Z^DIE17 routine.
bea82da4: Set default value for X to '?BAD'.
4d3d333c: Save the value of X in DZ, call D routine to set up field attributes, call QQ^DIEQ routine to validate the user input, and then go to node B.
85a4bcfb: Set up field attributes by assigning the field number to D, subfile number and logic values to DQ array node, and extracting field specifications from DATA section of DD global.

a09823aa: If there is no input data for this field, execute O routine. If the input is '@' and it is not allowed, go to node RD. If the input is '@' and it is allowed and the field is not read-only, go to node A. If the input is '@' and it is allowed, set X to Y. Otherwise, go to node N.
b970a768: Set the Data Global (DG) to the Global Root, Y to the Internal Value, and X to the User Value. If there is a BE/HELP transform, execute it.

e378afb8: If the Data Global contains a pointer to another file, get the External Value and Data Global Root from the pointed-to file. If the external value is null and the field is a multiple, get the .01 field value instead.

4df75b82: If the Data Global contains a variable pointer, get the External Value and Data Global Root from the pointed-to global. If the external value is null and the field is a multiple, get the .01 field value instead.
d19eefc9: If the Data Global contains a DBIA reference, execute the associated routine. If the Data Global contains a MUMPS literal, extract the value from the X input value.
